scope: Broaden the HATCH parity plan across exact file-data preservation, $MEASUREMENT/library fallback behavior, LibreCAD's current 2D adapter/renderer path, and consumer rendering resource limits.

method.kind: Primary specification and current open-source source review plus targeted local source/plan inspection
localFilesInspected: src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_Hatch DXF parseCode handling of pattern line angle, base, offset, and dash fields
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing 7AH patterned-HATCH retention, 7BJ measurement independence, and 2D LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 consumer gates

evidence.topic: Autodesk HATCH fields define wire data but not universal renderer policy
evidence.observed: The public DXF references define pattern line count and repeated angle, base-point, offset, dash-count, and dash-length fields. Group 47 is described as pixel size for associative/flood intersection and ray-casting computation. The public material reviewed does not define general viewport LOD, display-list caching, or a global run cap.
evidence.localObservation: Existing local model has DRW_Hatch::patternLines; its parser reads each field into typed values. This review did not run parser tests.
evidence.disposition: Keep file-level field preservation separate from renderer approximation, viewport clipping, export/pick policy, and performance qualification.

evidence.topic: $MEASUREMENT selects resource families and is not an embedded-line scaling rule
evidence.observed: Autodesk documents $MEASUREMENT as selecting imperial or metric hatch-pattern and linetype resource files. This does not establish that embedded HATCH pattern-line values should be multiplied by a unit factor.
evidence.localObservation: Existing plan work preserves $MEASUREMENT and $INSUNITS independently; this review adds no tests or code.
evidence.disposition: Preserve embedded pattern data exactly. Qualify library fallback selection only when embedded lines are absent and at the actual consumer route.

evidence.topic: CADCraft peer reports separate authored-pattern precedence and display-list scalability concerns
evidence.observed: CADCraft issue #544 and merged PR #638 report expensive full-area dash expansion and consumer-side viewport LOD/clipping while retaining full detail for plot/export/pick. Merged PR #643 reports preferring file-authored line definitions over same-name library entries and correcting metric library fallback behavior. Its input drawings were not made available in this research pass, so performance figures are peer-reported; its 16x pattern calibration and 1,000,000-run cap are project choices, not normative file limits.
evidence.localObservation: No CADCraft build, package, source checkout, or drawing was used. No local performance claim is made.
evidence.disposition: Use as a failure-mode and test-design lead only. Do not copy numeric factors, caps, timing results, or imply local behavior without pinned controlled evidence.

evidence.topic: Current LibreCAD source path drops typed HATCH pattern lines before native pattern expansion
evidence.observed: The inspected mutable LibreCAD master adapter constructs RS_Hatch from name, scale, and angle and translates boundary loops, but does not forward DRW_Hatch::patternLines. RS_Hatch::updatePatternHatch requests a named RS_Pattern, applies hatch scale, trims generated lines against loops, and refuses when the contour-to-pattern area ratio exceeds 1e4.
evidence.localObservation: This is a downstream consumer path observation, not evidence of a libdxfrw parser loss or pinned release/runtime behavior. The LibreCAD source revision was not pinned in this plan-only review.
evidence.disposition: At the existing 2D consumer checkpoint, either qualify and record this consumer-model limitation or open a separately scoped downstream adapter/model/render change if custom/overridden pattern fidelity is required. Do not alter libdxfrw's exact wire-data behavior to mimic a resource-library projection.

planImpact.fastNextAction: When the HATCH path is next changed, reuse the existing focused ASCII/Binary patterned-HATCH selectors for exact authored field roundtrip. Defer pinned LibreCAD import/edit/export checks and scratch-generated dense-pattern performance measurement to the existing composed consumer milestone.
planImpact.qualificationBoundary: Exact HATCH file fields, library fallback and $MEASUREMENT selection, LibreCAD visible/editable semantics, export fidelity, and rendering performance are independent evidence classes.
